_what: A read-only capture of the live COACH#*/PREDICTION# ledger, the input to deploy/prereg_provenance_gate.audit_prereg_provenance. Claim text is deliberately excluded: the contract keys on prediction_id, and the claims are already public in deploy/generated/genesis_preregistration.json.
_source: DynamoDB life-platform, us-west-2, read-only Query per partition
_query: for pk in prereg_provenance_gate.season_partitions(frozen): Query(pk=pk, sk begins_with 'PREDICTION#', ProjectionExpression='pk,sk,prediction_id,created_date,created_at,phase,cycle,tombstone,pre_registered,pre_registered_at,status')
_rows_included: ALL non-tombstoned rows, plus the first 20 tombstoned rows as a labelled sample. A tombstoned row can never change the verdict (in_season() drops it first), so the sample is here to exercise that filter on real wire rows, not to be exhaustive — the omission is declared rather than hidden.
